record_title: Sharp lag-one and spectral-ceiling envelopes for reversible Markov-chain variance
provenance: A sharp extremal theorem for autocorrelation and Monte Carlo variance of positive reversible Markov-chain observables with fixed lag-one correlation and optional spectral ceiling.
limitations: Requires nonnegative observable spectrum for the lower-envelope conclusions; the spectral ceiling may be observable-specific; rho and beta are treated as known rather than estimated; equivalent formulations may exist in classical moment-problem or operator-theoretic literature.
